baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual آمنوا واتقوا governs the paired emphatic outcomes لكفرنا and ولأدخلناهم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Inherited communal and textual belonging is neither sufficient status nor final exclusion. Settled trust plus self-protection requalifies the collective through an ordered repair: its ugly works are neutralized before it is transferred into flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Close belonging supplies the collective subject whose inherited affiliation remains open to change.
A binding written determination makes the book an accountable norm rather than a bare group label.
Heart-settling assent supplies the first positive condition for requalification.
Putting oneself in protection supplies the maintained practical condition beside assent.
Expiatory covering supplies the first consequence, rendering the bad acts as though no longer operative.
Ugliness and bad quality identify what must be neutralized before transfer.
Movement into an interior supplies the second consequence as a change of location and state.
A garden screened by its growth supplies the destination as a cultivated enclosure.
Good condition and beneficent ease define the quality of the destination.

changed_reading.before: A named group is promised forgiveness and paradise if it believes.
changed_reading.after: A text-affiliated collective remains conditionally requalifiable: trusted assent and protective practice cause a sequenced repair, first disabling its ugly works and then transferring it into cultivated flourishing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence اتقوا، كفرنا، أدخلناهم جنات links self-protection, covering, entry, and a screened garden.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah forms concentric changes in exposure. The subjects adopt a protective barrier, divine action covers the harmful record, and they are moved inside a tree-covered habitat of soft ease; acquittal becomes relocation into layered shelter.

activation_trace.role: A barrier that repels harm supplies the first protective layer.
Literal covering changes the exposure of what had made the subjects vulnerable.
Entry moves the repaired subjects across a boundary into the next layer.
The tree-screened garden makes the final protection a living habitat rather than a legal abstraction.
Softness and ease make sheltered life the positive opposite of merely escaping harm.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers legal cancellation followed by reward.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a layered change from vulnerability to self-guarding, covered liability, boundary crossing, and finally protected, easeful habitation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أهل الكتاب can activate both fitness for a role and a written determination or register, while أدخلناهم supplies admission.
baseline_models.mechanism: The inherited title contains a latent status question: ahl can mark fitness, and kitab can be a binding record or enrollment. Belief and guarding therefore do not merely add traits to a fixed identity; they requalify who is fit to be entered into a favorable company.

activation_trace.role: Fitness and entitlement turn communal identity into a question of actual qualification.
An enacted written judgment supplies the binding status against which qualification matters.
Enrollment of a name in a register supplies the exploratory image of changed company.
Trustworthiness and inner security supply the qualifying disposition.
Admission gives the possible register shift a concrete threshold outcome.

changed_reading.before: People of the Book is a static inherited designation.
changed_reading.after: The designation becomes a contested eligibility: possession of a binding record does not settle status, while trusted and guarded response makes admission into a new company possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 5:61 a spoken claim of belief leaves the interior cargo unchanged: the subjects enter carrying unbelief, exit carrying it, and conceal what is within. The focus ayah reuses belief, covering, and entry but reverses the carried content and destination: bad cargo is rendered inoperative before entry into the garden.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent is voiced in 5:61 but functions there as a claim whose effect is tested by the following threshold.
Literal entry establishes the earlier threshold trajectory that the focus ayah will reverse.
Truth-obscuring unbelief is the unchanged cargo carried through the earlier encounter.
Passage back outside completes a failed encounter in which no interior transformation occurred.
Concealment marks the split between spoken belief and retained inward content.
In the focus ayah assent is paired with guarding and becomes causally effective.
The repeated root changes polarity from carried unbelief to the covering that disables bad acts.
The repeated entry now completes transformation by crossing into a cultivated destination.

structural_cues: 5:61 juxtaposes saying 'we believe' with entering and leaving in unbelief; 5:65 repeats belief, covering, and entry with both the carried content and destination changed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical recurrence and threshold sequence; I supply the arrow that changed inward cargo enables changed destination. A live alternative is that 5:61 only tests sincerity without establishing a spatial trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Covering and admission are two independent promised benefits.
changed_reading.after: The pair reverses an earlier failed passage: instead of carrying concealed unbelief into and out of encounter unchanged, the subjects undergo effective repair and are led across a different threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent conditional in 5:66 makes textual belonging operational: revelation must be made upright, which opens nourishment from above and below and yields a moderate subgroup. The renewed address in 5:68 denies stable standing without that enactment. Thus the focus title is not possession alone, and gardens of bliss become the culmination of an upheld, provision-bearing order.

activation_trace.role: Fitness for a role makes 'people of' an enacted qualification rather than an automatic privilege.
The book as binding determination supplies the norm that must be upheld.
Beneficent good condition lets the later nourishment materially thicken the destination's bliss.
Rising with resolve to an affair turns scripture from possessed object into maintained practice.
What has been delivered supplies the vertical gift that the community must put into effect.
Edible provision makes successful establishment visible as sustained livelihood.
The upper direction supplies one side of an all-around provision field.
The lower direction closes the provision field around the established community.
Balance between extremes supplies the social form produced within the broader collective.
The renewed collective address keeps inherited belonging in view while its sufficiency is denied.
The same binding text anchors the explicit demand to establish rather than merely possess it.

structural_cues: 5:65 and 5:66 use consecutive counterfactual conditions; 5:68 then says the addressed People of the Book stand on nothing until they establish the delivered texts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies establishment, delivered revelation, all-around food, and moderation; I infer that these form the lived habitat toward which the focus promise points. The live alternative keeps 5:66's food temporal and 5:65's gardens wholly eschatological.

changed_reading.before: People who possess a book may receive a later paradise if they add belief.
changed_reading.after: Textual belonging must be made upright in practice; that enactment supports nourishment and moderation now, while admission to gardens becomes its culminating form rather than a reward for nominal possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding badness is a communal feedback system: people accelerate into what delays them from good, cross limits, consume illicitly, and fail to restrain one another from the repellent act. The focus plural 'their bad deeds' therefore includes reproduced social practices, while guarding supplies the missing boundary and brake.

activation_trace.role: A harm-blocking barrier supplies the focus mechanism that can interrupt a communal circuit.
Ugliness and bad quality anchor the circuit's outputs in the focus ayah's plural bad deeds.
Speed supplies the self-reinforcing momentum of the harmful practices.
Delay from good creates the paradoxical result of their accelerated movement.
Crossing the limit supplies the circuit's outward social injury.
Defective illicit gain makes corrupt consumption one material input to the circuit.
Restraint from action identifies the missing communal brake.
The ugly act that should be repelled names the socially tolerated output.

structural_cues: 5:62 clusters rapid motion, sin, transgression, and illicit consumption; 5:79 identifies failure of mutual restraint from enacted wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies linked behaviors and an absent brake; I supply the causal arrow that unrestrained practices reproduce communal badness. A live alternative treats each item as an aggregate of private faults rather than a system.

changed_reading.before: Their individual moral failures would be canceled.
changed_reading.after: The plural badness includes a socially reproduced circuit of speed, limit-crossing, corrupt consumption, and failed inhibition; belief and guarding imply repair of that circuit, not only private absolution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covenant history is recurrent rather than a single failed decision: unwelcome messengers meet denial or killing, an unanticipated test closes perception, a divine turn intervenes, and blindness and deafness recur. The focus pairing makes faith durable trust and taqwa the ongoing protection of responsiveness against relapse.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies a trust that must persist through unwelcome encounters.
Putting oneself in protection supplies the continuing discipline that keeps trust responsive.
The confirmed covenant supplies the durable relation repeatedly tested by later response.
Contradiction of truth supplies one recurrent rejection response.
Taking life supplies the intensified alternative when a message opposes desire.
Testing of human material supplies the pressure under which responsiveness is exposed.
Repeated blindness of insight supplies the recurring perceptual closure on both sides of the turn.
Repeated failure to listen supplies the auditory side of the relapse loop.

structural_cues: The 'whenever' pattern in 5:70 and the doubled blindness and deafness around a divine turn in 5:71 frame failure as recurrence rather than one isolated event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated messengers, two rejection modes, and doubled perceptual closure; I infer that guarding interrupts this relapse loop. A live alternative reads the sequence only as collective history, not as a mechanism internal to the focus condition.

changed_reading.before: A one-time act of belief and fear satisfies the condition.
changed_reading.after: The condition demands durable trust and guarded receptivity that survive disliked revelation and even recovery after failure, preventing the old blindness-and-deafness loop from returning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final pericope narrates a responsive subgroup moving through the focus template: hearing becomes understanding, signs become recognition, recognition becomes confessed trust and a request for inscription among witnesses, hope names admission, and returned recompense takes the form of enduring watered gardens. The counterfactual opening is thereby shown as a live trajectory rather than an abstract concession.

activation_trace.role: Enrollment in a register lies latent in the focus title and prepares the later request to be written into a company.
Settled assent supplies the focus condition enacted in the later response.
Admission supplies the threshold later voiced as hope.
The screened garden supplies the outcome later narrated as recompense.
Hearing as understanding and compliance initiates the realized response sequence.
Recognition by a perceptible mark converts reception into discriminating acknowledgment.
Confessed heart-settling assent realizes the focus condition within the narrated subgroup.
Writing a name into a register turns textual identity into requested enrollment among witnesses.
Knowledgeable declaration defines the company into which the responders seek inscription.
Hope in the heart makes admission an actively desired next threshold.
The repeated entry root voices the focus promise from the responders' side.
A deed's recompense returning to its doer converts hoped-for admission into narrated outcome.
The repeated screened garden explicitly realizes the focus destination.
Continuous provision adds sustaining flow to the garden's realized form.
Water cutting a channel through earth gives the promised habitat an enduring material circulation.

structural_cues: 5:82 identifies an affectively near, non-arrogant subgroup; 5:83-85 then sequences reception, recognition, belief, requested inscription, hoped-for admission, and awarded gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered sequence and repeated focus roots; I infer that 5:83-85 exemplifies one live path through 5:65. A live alternative treats the later reward as structurally parallel but not a deliberate realization of the counterfactual.

changed_reading.before: The ayah leaves an undifferentiated People of the Book in a hypothetical possibility.
changed_reading.after: A later subgroup enacts the possibility step by step: receptive recognition becomes trusted confession, new registration, hoped-for admission, and finally an awarded, continuously watered garden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The invitation to seek forgiveness in 5:74 joins protective covering of a wrongdoer to tenderness. This sharpens the focus takfir: bad acts are not hidden so they can continue, but covered in a turn that protects the person from their aftereffect and restores relation.

activation_trace.role: Expiatory covering anchors the focus repair as rendering bad acts inoperative.
Covering a fault while shielding its bearer from the effect supplies a person-protective direction for expiation.
Tender mercy makes the covering relational repair rather than impersonal deletion.

structural_cues: 5:74 asks for return and seeking forgiveness, then immediately names God as forgiving and merciful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two covering fields and mercy; I infer that the later pair clarifies the direction of the focus expiation. A live alternative treats takfir and maghfirah as adjacent juridical operations without a shelter mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The bad acts are canceled from an account.
changed_reading.after: Their operation is covered in a merciful repair that also shields the returning person from the acts' continuing effect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links branch-distant senses of badness, covering, and concealment. It remains anchored in the uninterrupted focus sequence from سيئاتهم to كفرنا to جنات, but downstream prose should present it only as an image-level reparative possibility, not claim that سيئات literally means nakedness here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سيئاتهم are covered before the subjects are admitted into جنات.

activation_trace.role: The shameful part normally kept covered supplies an exploratory image of exposed or exposure-producing badness.
Covering supplies the reversal from disgraceful exposure toward protected non-exposure.
Concealment from perception turns the destination into restored privacy rather than mere hiding.
The living, tree-screened garden makes restored covering fertile and habitable.

changed_reading.before: Bad deeds are erased before reward.
changed_reading.after: Disgrace-producing badness is re-covered and the repaired subjects are relocated within a living concealment; forgiveness restores protected dignity, not only a score.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain ecological reversal is surprising because 5:65 does not itself mention war, fire, corruption, or rivers. It remains valid as an activation because the focus destination is explicitly a cultivated garden and the packet places extinguished war-fire before it and flowing garden-water after it; downstream prose should qualify it as a pericope-scale image mechanism, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repaired endpoint in 5:65 is entry into gardens characterized by flourishing ease.

activation_trace.role: Ignition supplies the repeatedly produced destructive environment immediately before the focus.
War and hostility identify the social fuel whose environment must be reversed.
Cooling flame and ember supplies the interruption that makes another habitat imaginable.
Departure from sound balance names the damaged earthly order opposed to cultivation.
The cultivated, tree-screened garden anchors the focus endpoint of environmental reversal.
Beneficent good condition defines the garden as restored flourishing rather than mere absence of fire.
Continuous provision supplies the sustaining flow of the later garden image.
A watercourse cutting through earth gives concrete form to the cool, productive alternative.

changed_reading.before: Gardens are a reward appended after moral cancellation.
changed_reading.after: The garden is the positive ecology that replaces a self-renewing environment of ignition, war, and imbalance: cooled destruction gives way to continuously watered cultivation.

strongest_changes: The repeated belief, entry, and unbelief roots in 5:61 turn 5:65 into a reversal of entering and leaving with corrupt inward cargo still carried.
The adjacent conditions in 5:66 and 5:68 convert People of the Book from nominal possession into establishing revelation, linked to nourishment and moderation.
The social clusters in 5:62 and 5:79 expand bad deeds from private faults into a reproduced circuit with a missing communal brake.
The sequence in 5:83-85 narrates a receptive subgroup moving from recognition to inscription among witnesses, hoped-for admission, and actual watered gardens.
summary.what_was_special: Across the four-pericope packet, 5:65 works as both hinge and template: it reverses the preceding failed threshold, reframes textual identity as enacted qualification, and anticipates a later realized response, while its own branches expose a nested shelter topology.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 5:66's nourishment from above and below should materially inflect gardens of bliss or remain a separate temporal promise.
Whether 5:83-85 is a direct realization of 5:65 or only a structurally parallel reward sequence.
The shame-to-shelter and fire-to-watered-habitat readings are image-level activations, not lexical disambiguations.
